prior_year_events.impact_description: 2016 year of account currently forecasts closing with a loss on capacity of 20%
The 2015 year of account declares a return on capacity of 2.1%

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased from GBP 11.788m at 1 January 2017 to GBP 12.814m at 31 December 2017 (gross movement +GBP 1.422m for the year). The syndicate describes mixed prior year development: a positive outcome for the 2015 year of account (return on capacity 2.1%) but an adverse underwriting event impacting the 2016 year of account (forecast loss on capacity of 20%). No explicit gross prior-year movement figure was disclosed in the movement note or narrative that can be unambiguously extracted.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2015 year of account declares a return on capacity of 2.1%.
Due to an adverse underwriting event the 2016 year of account currently forecasts closing with a loss on capacity of 20%.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found in the available pages. The balance sheet gross opening claims outstanding was taken from the prior-year comparative column. The report discusses prior-year outcomes qualitatively (2015 positive, 2016 adverse) but does not quantify a gross prior-year development amount that can be directly extracted; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. A gross claims development table exists but the printed layout in the provided extract prevents reliable diagonal comparison to compute PYD; the triangle was not used to compute a numeric PYD. The operating division breakdown is 'Life insurance' / 'Life reinsurance' (used for premium mix) which does not map cleanly to standard Lloyd's LOBs.
